name: pinv
expr: PA = pinv(A); err1 = max(max(abs(A*PA*A - A))); err2 = max(max(abs(PA*A*PA - PA))); PB = pinv(B); err3 = max(max(abs(B*PB*B - B)));
comment: Sig: P = pinv(A[, tol]). Moore-Penrose pseudoinverse via SVD: A*P*A = A, P*A*P = P (verified to ulp). Bit-identical with MATLAB R2025b on probed full-rank + rank-deficient cases.
